description: Configuration for context-loader.js (Context Management Layer, framework 1.5.0). Repository-specific knobs only; the loader logic and the canonical loading policy live elsewhere (Knowledge Separation, ../CLAUDE.md; canonical policy constitution/CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS.md). This file names paths and the token-cost model; it never restates what to load — that is the authored EXECUTION_MANIFEST/BOOT_MANIFEST.

tokenModel.note: Deterministic proxy: ceil(fileBytes / bytesPerToken). Used only for relative reduction reporting, never as an authoritative token count.

universe.note: The 'full load' baseline against which minimisation is measured: every authoritative document a naive, non-manifest boot would read.
